One AI search-summary claimed 'Hathusar is a tank firing range area within the Mahajan Field Firing Range' but the underlying Wikimapia page returned no retrievable content and OpenStreetMap's own tags for the range do not confirm it - flagged as unverified, needs manual check on Wikimapia/Google Maps/OSM directly.
